There are many remarkable moments that make cruising aboard Fred. Olsen’s smaller ships so special and no one can explain it better than our guests themselves.
Watch here ▸
“The scenery was stunning. No need to run round the ship for the best vantage spot. Our Captain and his crew happily spun the ship in the middle of the Norwegian Fjords so everyone had a good photo opportunity.”
“We had some amazing food in all the restaurants. My husband suggested we try Colours & Tastes, speciality Asian fusion restaurant one evening for an extra special treat, it was sensational.”
“Cruising with Fred. Olsen is my ‘happy place. From the minute I step on board, I feel at home. I just love the warm feeling you get when greeted by crew met on previous cruises”
Ms Wade
“The food, the service, the shows, the smiles, the kindness – I wish the Fred. Olsen feeling could be bottled and sold. If I could mention all the special moments, I’d never stop”
Ms Jones
“We were dining in the Avon restaurant and during the course of the meal I saw a humpback whale breaching. I called out and everyone dropped their forks, knives and spoons and dashed to the windows to witness this experience."
Mr Todd
We'd love for you to join us on board soon to create your own cherished memories.
